# Petri Pools

> Family-run pool remodeling and pool equipment repair company in Lewisville, Texas, serving North Dallas–Fort Worth since June 2000. Phone (972) 219-8700. BBB accredited since 2009, rated A+.

## Services

- [Pool remodeling](https://www.petripools.com/#remodel): new waterline tile, coping, interior finish (Quartzscapes plaster, Designer Series plaster, Stonescapes pebble) and decking. Samples at the Lewisville showroom.
- [Pool equipment repair](https://www.petripools.com/#repair): repair or replacement of pumps, motors, heaters, filters, pool cleaners and automation systems, all major brands. Electrical work by licensed electrical contractors (TICL #593). Petri Pools does not do leak detection.

## Company

- [About](https://www.petripools.com/#about): opened by Justin Petri in June 2000; family owned and operated; A Best Pick Certified Company (Best Pick Reports).
- [Reviews](https://www.petripools.com/#reviews): 43 customer testimonials with their towns.
- [Free estimate](https://www.petripools.com/#estimate): showroom at 1702 S. State Hwy 121, Suite 602, Lewisville, TX 75067. Office hours Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Central Time. Email petripools@gmail.com.

Lewisville, Highland Village, Flower Mound, Plano, Dallas, Farmers Branch, Addison, Carrollton, Frisco, The Colony, Coppell, Irving, Grapevine, Southlake, Colleyville, North Richland Hills, Bedford, Euless, Keller, Trophy Club, Westlake, Corinth, Argyle, Copper Canyon, Double Oak, McKinney, Allen, Richardson, Denton, Little Elm, North Arlington, North Grand Prairie, Garland, University Park, Highland Park, Fairview, Parker, Murphy, Prosper.
